content: To kapalana molaguna. Zaburuna miana Korah.

content.text: Perangoia o giu incia sii, e bhari-bharia lipu,
taaia o talingamiu e bhari-bharia raʼeatina dunia,
Malape o kaogesa atawa o mia maidhiidhi,
mia morangkaea atawa o mia misikini!
Ngangaku bheabhoasaka manga pogau imembaliakamiu ubukeaka hikimati,
tee ngangarandaku bheafikiri manga giu imembaliakamiu umakidha umaʼanaia.
Talingaku bhekubungkalea to kuperangoi manga kabhanti moʼaarifu,
poose kumagasiaaka kecapi, bhekubhoasakea maʼanana o taataangkeku.
Iaku inda kufaraluu kumaeka i wakutuuna kaseke,
wakutuuna kadhakina musuku alibuaku.
Manga incia mia motangkaakana harataana
tee mosomboakana karangkaeana.
Satotuuna, inda samia uka momembalina mopasalaamatina karona samia,
atawa apomea katolosina i Aulataʼala to apamembalia kabholosina inyawana
roonamo ponambona katolosina inyawana mia amaali mpuu,
tee inda bheakawa moomini apomeaia tee opeapo uka
mamudhaakana incia amembali adhadhi saʼumurua
tee inda bheakamata bhalona koburuna.
Maka satotuuna, incia bheakamata
mia moʼaarifu uka bheamate,
mboo sumai uka tee mia mokabhongo-bhongo tee mia mobhore;
manga incia bheabholi harataana to mia mosagaanana.
Koburuna manga incia bheamembali bhanuana saʼumurua,
mbooresana manga incia asadhaadhaa to saʼumurua,
moomini manga incia dhaangia tee tanana karona.
Maka o maanusia moomini tee karangkaeana inda bheamembali adhadhi torosu.
Maanusia apokana tee binata dhaanamo bheabinasa.
Mboo siimo dhawuana mia motangkaakana karona,
tee ajalana manga mia momaasiakana pogauna karona. Sela
Aulataʼala apatotapuaka manga incia to amate mboomo dumba,
manga incia awulua mboomo dumba apesua i bhalona koburu,
manga incia bheasapo lausaka i nuncana koburu.
Badana manga incia bheamabuto tee ahancuru,
amaridho minaaka i bhanuana.
Maka o Aulataʼala bheatolosiaku
minaaka i duniana mia mate
roonamo Incia bheaalaaku minaaka iwe sumai. Sela
Bholi umaeka ande o mia mosagaanana amembali arangkaea,
tee o harataana ahandamo abhari,
roonamo wakutuuna amate, incia inda amembali abhawa opeopeapo uka,
tee o harataana inda bheasapo i koburu to apobhawa tee incia.
Moomini kangengena dhadhina incia aabhi karona atobarakati
tee apuji-pujia mia roonamo akodhawua,
incia uka bheatutuni manga opu-opuana,
momatena porikana i tampa momalalanda
tee iwe sumai, indamo uka bheakamata kainawa pendua.
Maanusia morangkaea, maka inda amembali amaʼanai hikimati,
amembali tapapokanea tee binata motopabinasa.

footnotes.text: Sela: Aipomo tandana to aunto wakutuuna lagu sumai atolaguaka, atawa o tanda to ahanda apekaogea o suarana, atawa onina gambusuna. Amembali uka to tanda to morangoa mamudhaakana asuju.
